submit_report.description: Own assigned visit only; atomic version update and append-only idempotent report

steps.sql: UPDATE calliope_apps.northstar_visits v SET notes=$2::jsonb->>'notes',status='Submitted',version=version+1,current_report=$3::uuid,last_request_id=$3::uuid WHERE v.id=$2::jsonb->>'id' AND v.version=($2::jsonb->>'version')::integer AND v.status IN ('Assigned','Follow-up') AND v.assigned_to=$1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.northstar_staff s WHERE s.email=$1 AND s.active AND s.role='technician') AND length(trim($2::jsonb->>'notes')) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000 AND jsonb_typeof($2::jsonb->'attachments')='array' AND jsonb_array_length($2::jsonb->'attachments')<=5 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb->'attachments') a WHERE jsonb_typeof(a)<>'string' OR trim(both '"' from a::text)!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.northstar_reports r WHERE r.request_id=$3::uuid) RETURNING v.id,v.version

INSERT INTO calliope_apps.northstar_reports(id,visit_id,request_id,submitted_by,visit_version,notes,attachment_ids,attachment_names) SELECT $3::uuid,v.id,$3::uuid,$1,v.version,v.notes,$2::jsonb->'attachments',coalesce($4::jsonb,'{}'::jsonb) FROM calliope_apps.northstar_visits v WHERE v.id=$2::jsonb->>'id' AND v.version=($2::jsonb->>'version')::integer+1 AND v.status='Submitted' AND v.current_report=$3::uuid AND v.last_request_id=$3::uuid AND v.assigned_to=$1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.northstar_staff s WHERE s.email=$1 AND s.active AND s.role='technician') AND jsonb_typeof($2::jsonb->'attachments')='array' AND jsonb_array_length($2::jsonb->'attachments')<=5 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb->'attachments') a WHERE jsonb_typeof(a)<>'string' OR trim(both '"' from a::text)!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') RETURNING id,visit_id,submitted_by
